T_k: The correction combines a smaller, centred, saturating even x4 term (damped when |x5| is large) with a steeper and slightly stronger x2*x5 interaction. The interaction is now the main driver: it raises predictions by up to 0.25 when x2 and x5 share a sign and lowers them by as much when the signs differ, and it saturates quickly so that even moderate products have an effect.
